Sylas

the Unshackled
Mid laneJungle laneTop laneSupport lane

Support Sylas is a niche, weaker pick right now: it wins only about 46.7% of games on op.gg. He's still worth it when your team needs a second engage and the enemy has big ultimates to steal, or when you're very comfortable on him. He plays like a burst mage who dives the enemy bot lane with Abduct and Electrocute.

When to pick Sylas

✗ Better as a counter-pick

No. It's a niche pick with a low win rate this patch, so only pick it into the right matchup.

Pick into

  • Squishy mage supports he can dive, like Vel'Koz, Zyra and Neeko
  • Enemy teams with strong ultimates to steal
  • When your team needs a second engage and you're very comfortable on Sylas

Avoid into

  • Hard-engage supports like Braum, Rell and Leona
  • When your team needs heals, shields or lots of vision
  • When you're not already a confident Sylas player

Great teammates

JhinHis long-range root follows your engage.
Miss FortuneHer ultimate wrecks enemies after your engage.
JinxShe follows up and cleans up after your dives.

Your team needs: Pick support Sylas only when your team needs a second engage and you're facing a squishy enemy support.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Abduct (E2) engages on the enemy bot lane and knocks up the target
  • Strong level 2-3 all-ins with Electrocute
  • Steals the enemy support's or ADC's ultimate in the 2v2
  • Area damage helps your ADC win skirmishes

Weaknesses

  • Weak win rate this patch: most matchups are below 50%
  • Short range: engage supports like Braum and Leona beat him
  • No heals or shields for your ADC
  • Needs items to stay relevant while having support gold

Power spikes

  • Level 2: E-Q engage with Electrocute; push for level 2 first with your ADC
  • Level 6: Hijack; engage-support ultimates are great steals
  • Support item upgrade: Celestial Opposition wins more than Zaz'Zak's Realmspike this patch
  • First item (Hextech Rocketbelt): extra dash for picks and roams

Top tips

  • Only pick Sylas support when you're comfortable and the enemy has strong ultimates to steal
  • Push for level 2 first and engage with Abduct
  • Avoid hard-engage supports like Braum, Rell and Leona
  • Take Celestial Opposition as your support item upgrade this patch
  • Keep Control Wards stored in your quest slot and place them before objectives
  • Steal the enemy support's engage ultimate and use it in teamfights
